_comment: Proposed thresholds for the Quantum health monitor. The monitor evaluates 60-second rolling windows built from small, cheap probes (ICMP/UDP RTT + loss) — never large speed tests. Hysteresis: a state change requires N consecutive failing (or recovering) windows, so temporary fluctuations never flip the state.

hysteresis._rationale: 2 failing 60s windows = degrade after ~2min of sustained badness; 3 good windows = recover after ~3min of sustained goodness. Asymmetric on purpose: flap less towards 'down', restore quickly enough to be useful.

severities.down: zero successful probes in a window

probe_profile.udp_fallback: same schedule; ICMP blocked paths use the UDP echo probe
probe_profile.speedtest_policy: large transfers are NOT part of the rolling window; they run only in scheduled lab/validation runs

profile_expectations._comment: Scenario-specific expectation overlays used by the lab acceptance checks; the monitor itself uses window_fail_when.
